decision: Accepted local R11 containment and commercial/identity behavior within the evidence below
review: Membership mutations condition observed subject/team/role/session version and revoke refresh in the same successful transaction; stale CAS does not revoke newer sessions.

New issue/resend/consume use persisted canonical multi-user rights, refresh the locked subscription after account-to-subscription lock ordering, and reject lost rights with402. Existing members can still be managed or revoked.

Real fullstack verifies Free refusal, valid Clinic invitation, explicit logout, one-use claim, persisted role/access, access+refresh revocation and retained personal weight. Historical gym-typed professionals retain personal access while owners without membership do not.
Own entitlement tests keep existing catalog booleans and introduce no team/device maximum. M04 test settings are restored before cache reload so combined ordering is meaningful.
limits: No real email delivery/provider sandbox; truthful not_confirmed remains.
Browser persistence is isolated SQLite; RLS channels have separate UUID PostgreSQL acceptance.
WCAG axe AA is automated coverage, not a complete assisted-accessibility audit.
